40 weeks + 7 days = 40 × 7 + 7 = 287 days.  
1153 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
From 1153-03-11 add 287 days:  
March: 31 - 11 = 20 days used → 267 days left.  
April: 30 → 237 left.  
May: 31 → 206 left.  
June: 30 → 176 left.  
July: 31 → 145 left.  
August: 31 → 114 left.  
September: 30 → 84 left.  
October: 31 → 53 left.  
November: 30 → 23 left.  
December: 31 → goes into next year.  
1153-12-31 + 23 days = 1154-01-23.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1154-01-23
